premises.text: Managing servers on public clouds like AWS is tedious, error-prone, and costly in engineering time
premises.evidence_span: Every year, businesses spend billions of dollars in engineering costs just to manage servers on AWS

premises.text: Render is a fully automated cloud that deploys from static sites to complex clusters without managing servers
premises.evidence_span: Render is a completely automated cloud provider. Render lets you deploy anything from a simple static site to complex application clusters

premises.text: Pushing code to Git triggers automated build, deploy, updates, security, scaling, load balancing, and alerting
premises.evidence_span: Simply push your code to Git. We automate everything from there

premises.text: Every Render service gets built-in service discovery, private networking, and load balancing
premises.evidence_span: every Render service gets built-in service discovery, private networking, and load balancing

premises.text: Fully managed SSDs with automatic backups and one-click restores
premises.evidence_span: Render is the first fully managed cloud to offer SSDs with automatic backups and one-click restores

premises.text: All Render services can be defined in one file and updated by pushing that file to Git
premises.evidence_span: You can define all your render services in just one file. You can update your infrastructure by simply pushing this file to Git

premises.text: Render is much cheaper than stagnating managed peers like Heroku while combining ease of use with flexibility
premises.evidence_span: Just two gigabytes of RAM costs $250 a month on Heroku compared to $25 a month on Render

value.text: Save engineering costs by automating cloud hosting without managing servers
value.evidence_span: looking to save big on engineering costs, automate your cloud hosting today
